export type StatName = 'vibe' | 'architecture' | 'protocol' | 'command'

  vibe: number
  architecture: number
  protocol: number
  command: number

  id: string
  name: string

  description: string
  recruitedAt: string

  id: string
  name: string
  realWorldTool: string
  description: string
  icon: string

}

export type MissionStatus = 'locked' | 'available' | 'in_progress' | 'completed'

export interface MissionProgress {
  missionId: string
  status: MissionStatus

  completedAt?: string
}

export type ChallengeType = 'prompt-duel' | 'architect' | 'connect' | 'debug' | 'command' | 'dialogue'

export interface Mission {
  id: string
  planetId: PlanetId
  title: string
  subtitle: string
  description: string
  challengeType: ChallengeType
  statRewards: Partial<PlayerStats>
  itemReward?: string
  crewReward?: string

}

export interface MissionContent {
  briefing: DialogueNode[]
  learning: LearningBlock[]
  challenge: ChallengeData
  debrief: DialogueNode[]
}

export interface DialogueNode {
  speaker: string
  text: string
  choices?: DialogueChoice[]
}

export interface DialogueChoice {
  text: string
  correct?: boolean
  response?: string
  nextNodeIndex?: number
}

export interface LearningBlock {
  type: 'text' | 'code' | 'stat' | 'image'
  content: string
  highlight?: boolean
}

export interface ChallengeData {
  type: ChallengeType
  instructions: string
  data: Record<string, unknown>
  passingScore: number
}

export type PlanetId = 'vibe-world' | 'debt-belt' | 'mcp-station' | 'agent-academy' | 'framework-nebula' | 'orchestration-citadel' | 'security-fortress' | 'production-worlds'
export type PlanetStatus = 'locked' | 'available' | 'in_progress' | 'completed'

export interface GameState {
  callsign: string
  ship: ShipType
  stats: PlayerStats
  crew: string[]
  inventory: string[]
  missionProgress: Record<string, MissionProgress>
  currentPlanet?: PlanetId
  currentMission?: string
  createdAt: string
  lastPlayedAt: string
}

1→'use client'
     2→
     3→import { createContext, useContext, useState, useCallback, useEffect, ReactNode } from 'react'
     4→import { GameState, PlayerStats, ShipType } from './types'
     5→import { createNewGame, saveGame, loadGame, deleteGame, completeMission as completeMissionFn, getRank, getTotalStats, getCompletedMissionCount } from './game-state'
     6→
     7→interface GameContextType {
     8→  state: GameState | null
     9→  loading: boolean
    10→  startNewGame: (callsign: string, ship: ShipType) => void
    11→  resetGame: () => void
    12→  completeMission: (missionId: string, score: number, statRewards: Partial<PlayerStats>, itemReward?: string, crewReward?: string) => void
    13→  rank: string
    14→  totalStats: number
    15→  completedMissions: number
    16→}
    17→
    18→const GameContext = createContext<GameContextType | null>(null)
    19→
    20→export function GameProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
    21→  const [state, setState] = useState<GameState | null>(null)
    22→  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)
    23→
    24→  useEffect(() => {
    25→    const saved = loadGame()
    26→    setState(saved)
    27→    setLoading(false)
    28→  }, [])
    29→
    30→  const startNewGame = useCallback((callsign: string, ship: ShipType) => {
    31→    const newState = createNewGame(callsign, ship)
    32→    saveGame(newState)
    33→    setState(newState)
    34→  }, [])
    35→
    36→  const resetGame = useCallback(() => {
    37→    deleteGame()
    38→    setState(null)
    39→  }, [])
    40→
    41→  const completeMissionCb = useCallback((missionId: string, score: number, statRewards: Partial<PlayerStats>, itemReward?: string, crewReward?: string) => {
    42→    setState(prev => {
    43→      if (!prev) return prev
    44→      return completeMissionFn(prev, missionId, score, statRewards, itemReward, crewReward)
    45→    })
    46→  }, [])
    47→
    48→  const rank = state ? getRank(state.stats) : 'Cadet'
    49→  const totalStats = state ? getTotalStats(state.stats) : 4
    50→  const completedMissions = state ? getCompletedMissionCount(state) : 0
    51→
    52→  return (
    53→    <GameContext.Provider value={{
    54→      state,
    55→      loading,
    56→      startNewGame,
    57→      resetGame,
    58→      completeMission: completeMissionCb,
    59→      rank,
    60→      totalStats,
    61→      completedMissions,
    62→    }}>
    63→      {children}
    64→    </GameContext.Provider>
    65→  )
    66→}
    67→
    68→export function useGame() {
    69→  const context = useContext(GameContext)
    70→  if (!context) {
    71→    throw new Error('useGame must be used within a GameProvider')
    72→  }
    73→  return context
    74→}
